additional_info.subject: RE: ID0444476-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/SD314015297001]Plug 1 malfunctioning CRM:02681000654
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Thank you for the information.
You're right—the issue occurs when a remote StartTransaction is triggered. This is a known issue in our older software version (you're currently on version 6.1.3). To resolve it, I recommend updating the charger to the latest version 8.0.5.
Would you like me to proceed with the update?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
